objective: Determine whether the frozen classifier is fit as a non-authoritative top-k evidence channel for agent-selected glyph inspection, rather than as a closed-vocabulary forced-choice replacement.
triggering_finding: The rejected v1 run missed pair coverage only because 60 pairs contained at least one form absent from the MTHv2 training vocabulary; common modern or erroneous alternatives such as 日, 念, 會, 增, and 查 are absent even though the printed gold form is usually represented. Toolbelt7 consumes top-k suggestions for a visible crop and never needs a logit for every proposed alternative.

evaluation.probe: The same frozen 1,131 local-only crop pack; no crops, gold, labels, model weights, or preprocessing change.
evaluation.eligible_instance: gold_char exists literally in the frozen class vocabulary
evaluation.diagnostic_only: Pairwise accuracy where the alternative also exists remains descriptive and cannot substitute for a failed identification gate.
evaluation.decision_rule: Accept as an evidence channel only if every hard gate passes. Acceptance does not authorize automated text replacement: the agent must inspect the crop, and the classifier remains a suggestion.

allowed_changes: library/evaluations/objects/** only after every gate passes
palimpsest/factory/stations/transcribe_omp_toolbelt7.py only after every gate passes and before its separate preflight
non_goals: No production, recipe, suite, or gold changes.
No automatic character replacement from classifier output.
No reinterpretation of the rejected v1 forced-choice gate.
next_permitted_action: Implement the frozen identification scorer, run it once on the local-only probe, and record every hard gate before integrating any object into toolbelt7.
